blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom is fun to be around.
exercises.why: **соскучиться → соскучишься** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I knew this moment would come.
exercises.why: **настать → настанет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: It sums up the situation pretty well.
exercises.why: **резюмировать → резюмирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Turn left when you get to the fork in the road.
exercises.why: **дойти → дойдёте** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You're not buying this, are you?
exercises.why: **повестись → поведётесь** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Will the judge fine him heavily?
exercises.why: **взыскать → взыщет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: The ice is going to break under your weight.
exercises.why: **проломиться → проломится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: This scandal will not soon be forgotten.
exercises.why: **забыться → забудется** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: All right, I will do it again.
exercises.why: **переделать → переделаю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: We'll drop you off on the way.
exercises.why: **завезти → завезём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Great! I'll grab my stuff!
exercises.why: **собрать → соберу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I won't leave you again.
exercises.why: **покинуть → покину** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я навсегда ___ (запомнить) звонкий смех и заразительную улыбку Марии.
exercises.prompt: I'll always remember Maria's great laugh and infectious smile.
exercises.why: **запомнить → запомню** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Посмотрите на эти фотографии. Возможно, это ___ (подстегнуть) вашу память.
exercises.prompt: Look at these photos, maybe they'll jog your memory.
exercises.why: **подстегнуть → подстегнёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's try to be more tolerant.
exercises.why: **постараться → Постараемся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Could you sharpen my knife for me?
exercises.why: **наточить → наточишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если слово не отработать хоть раз, его не ___ (заучить).
exercises.prompt: If you don't practice a word at least once, you can't learn it.
exercises.why: **заучить → заучишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's build a bonfire!
exercises.why: **разжечь → разожжём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: What are you wearing to graduation?
exercises.why: **одеть → оденешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: So are you translating or twiddling your fingers?
exercises.why: **переводить → переводишь** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
